title: Adjacent transitions of second-ideal algebraizations lift and induce quotients
statement: Let X be a Noetherian scheme and I,K quasi-coherent ideals. Let M be a coherent I-adic formal module [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module]. Assume completion on V(K^r) with extended ideal I is an equivalence for every r ≥ 1. For each e ≥ 0 let G_e be a coherent module on V(K^(e+1)), let F_e be its closed pushforward, and fix an isomorphism β_e from the I-completion of F_e to the system (M_n/K^(e+1)M_n)_n. Then K^(e+1)F_e=0, and there exists t_e:F_(e+1)→F_e such that (i) an isomorphism q_e:F_(e+1)/K^(e+1)F_(e+1)→F_e satisfies π_K q_e=t_e, and (ii) completion(t_e) β_e=β_(e+1) B(e+1→e), where B is the double quotient system and B(e+1→e) its induced adjacent K-transition.

proof.text: Finite closed pushforward gives coherent modules F_e. Use the proved private power_inclusion_iso, product_inclusion_iso and product_zero_iff helpers of ThickeningSystemPushforwardAdic to identify recursive ideal-power annihilation with annihilation by the closed ideal. closedImmersion_pushforward_annihilated gives K^(e+1) F_e = 0. formalModuleQuotient_factor transfers this annihilation to the larger power K^(e+2).

Prove the private supportedCompletion_fullyFaithful lemma: closedImmersion_coherent_equivalence identifies coherent modules killed by the closed ideal with coherent modules on the closed subscheme. The completion comparison of closedImmersion_coherentFormal_equivalence identifies completion after closed pushforward with completion on the subscheme followed by termwise pushforward. Closed pushforward is fully faithful, as is its whiskering on inverse systems; completion on the subscheme is fully faithful by hthick. Transport fullness and faithfulness across these natural isomorphisms and the coherent equivalence counit. At exponent e+2, lift beta_(e+1) followed by the double-system transition and beta_e inverse through this full functor. Its map_preimage equation proves the required completion square.

The target annihilation and formalModuleQuotient_factor make t kill the source K^(e+1) product. Define its factor s by cokernel.desc, obtaining pi_K followed by s = t. At each I-level, compare completion(s) followed by beta_e with the composite of the quotient-interchange isomorphism, the K-quotient of beta_(e+1), and the proved private formalModuleQuotient_iterated isomorphism of CoherentFormalModule. Precompose with the two epimorphic quotient projections. The projection equation of the interchange, quotient-map naturality, the iterated-quotient projection equation, and the completion square identify both composites. Thus every component of completion(s) is an isomorphism, so completion(s) is an isomorphism. The quotient is coherent and killed by K^(e+1) by formalCompletionSystem_coherent. Apply full faithfulness on the smaller thickening to reflect this isomorphism; asIso s supplies q and its projection equation is cokernel.pi_desc.
